editorial.blurb: Strings Ramen Shop serves some of the finest ramen in the country, with thoughtfully crafted broths and premium proteins that keep diners coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Call ahead to confirm availability of special items like the 10-year Anniversary ramen with beef rib, and the staff will watch for your order—they're known for going the extra mile.
